descriptions.d19c_intro_fade_80126884: Intro fade-in: enter scope 3, load the "Intro.Musy" logo (+128) and "Intro.License" (+124) nodes with their positions and scales, set the fading flag, then for 40 steps raise a grey level by 6.375, set it as an opaque colour on both meshes and call the intro's update; finally swap the fading flag for the faded flag.
